# clock TURN DAY EPOCH sets the short/short/int fields, dump prints them
# and the actual oly_month/oly_year macros. increment N calls the real
# routine N times; turn_change prepares day zero, NOT day one.
# dot N CHAR calls print_dot N times. stage TEXT / stage_empty / stage_null
# exercise the existing stage routine. time_self N sets timing mode; each
# timing case calls stage only once while enabled, so output is deterministic.
